newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya police enter university campus, fire teargas.
newsitem.headline: Kenya police enter university campus, fire teargas.

text.p: Heavily armed police units stormed Nairobi university on Wednesday and fired teargas to disperse defiant students who heeded a call for more protests by opposition groups demanding constitutional reforms, witnesses said.
"The police have entered the main university campus. They are firing teargas to disperse the students who are refusing to go home," a reporter at the scene told Reuters.
